# hush_mcp_application (Data Source)

An MCP application, read by id or by display name. The client secret is never returned, so the data source has no attribute for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An application managed in the console, looked up by the name it is shown
# under.
data "hush_mcp_application" "github" {
  display_name = "GitHub"
}

output "github_blocked_tools" {
  value = [for tool in data.hush_mcp_application.github.tools : tool.name if tool.operation == "block"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The name the application is shown under, which is unique within the organization. One of id or display_name is required.
- `id` (String) The application's id. One of id or display_name is required.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_agents` (Set of String) The agent types the application is limited to; empty when any agent may use it.
- `app_catalog_id` (String) The catalog entry the application was created from, or 'custom-<name>' for a custom app.
- `assign_all` (Boolean) Whether the application is granted to every user of the organization.
- `assignment` (List of Object) The rules granting the application: it is granted by any rule that matches, and a rule matches when all of its conditions do. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignment))
- `catalog_display_name` (String) The name the catalog shows for the entry.
- `client_id` (String) The client id of the OAuth app registered with the server, or empty when there is none.
- `deployment_ids` (Set of String) The deployments whose gateways serve the application.
- `description` (String) A description of the application.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateways serve the application. A disabled application keeps its configuration.
- `google_project_id` (String) The Google Cloud project a Google Workspace server bills its quota to; empty for other entries.
- `hosted` (Boolean) Whether Hush hosts the server.
- `name` (String) The name agents see the application under: the catalog id, suffixed with the lowercased `url_label` when one was picked.
- `oauth_relay` (Boolean) Whether the server's OAuth flow goes through Hush's relay.
- `quickbooks` (List of Object) The QuickBooks company, for the 'quickbooks' entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quickbooks))
- `scopes` (List of String) The OAuth scopes the application requests from the server.
- `tool_defaults` (List of Object) What the gateway does with a call to a tool of each class, unless the tool has an operation of its own. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool_defaults))
- `tool_operation` (Set of Object) The tools with an operation of their own, overriding their class default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool_operation))
- `tools` (List of Object) The tools the application offers, as copied from its catalog entry or custom app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))
- `url` (String) The address the gateway reaches the server at. Empty for a server Hush hosts.
- `url_label` (String) The label of the entry's address the application uses, lowercased, or empty when the entry has one address.
